historical_context.time_period: Undated Sa'ueia route life; no fixture-specific imperial presence
historical_context.location: Low Bend, a fixture-local ford where an upland candle fungal road meets a lantern grove, prismwake wetland shelf, and the current leading to a nearby choir-reef river mouth.
historical_context.summary: A temporary route assembly tests who has standing to carry ecological signals after floodwater spreads mirror amoebae from a fungal corpse pocket toward a choir reef nursery while a heat-stressed glassback herd needs passage before eclipse.

public_facts.text: Route assemblies are temporary local jurisdictions. Their path-opener, bearers, and record-keeper lose office when the hearing ends.
Families speak for their own conduct and custody. A grove, road, river colony, or herd participates through current signals carried and cross-checked in its own available channels.
Route remedies bind named parties and traffic channels at one locality; they do not create continent-wide authority.
A second crossing is a costly fresh hearing with new signals and bearers, not automatic suspension of the first remedy.

ambient_pressures.text: Eclipse consumes safe travel light and glassback heat while careful evidence gathering takes time.
A road can accept dead tissue under its own contract while a downstream reef can still treat flood-carried residue as nursery contamination.
No single ecological signal is omniscient; pressure song, candle behavior, archive custody, ant traces, courier residue, herd plates, and grove lights answer different questions.

groups.label: Low Bend route assembly
institutional_logic: Make conflicting ecological claims inspectable long enough to establish injury, standing, and the smallest recognized repair.
material_incentives: Preserve passage, prevent nursery contamination, keep the herd alive, protect selective archive custody, and make correction possible without permanent office.
internal_shames: Speaking for a body that has not answered
Opening lineage memory to win a local case
prestige_markers: A remedy recognized through several channels
A clean record another crossing can inspect
A severe closure that names its cost
taboo_triggers: Forcing reproductive or nursery traffic before slow parties can answer
emotional_display_norms: Frustration is allowed; certainty must be sourced. Humor vents delay but does not erase injury.
trust_defaults: Trust live local responses, bounded archive layers, and independent cross-checks more than inherited reputation alone.

groups.label: Road, grove, river colony, mats, ants, couriers, and herd at Low Bend
institutional_logic: Protect distinct nutritional, reproductive, memory, migration, and boundary interests through signals and material refusal.
material_incentives: Road nutrition, grove root integrity, reef nursery safety, mat regrowth, ant brood payment, courier route credit, and herd heat and calving access.
internal_shames: A claim carried through a corrupted channel
prestige_markers: Signals other bodies continue to recognize
emotional_display_norms: Pressure, light, taste, route opening, plate state, and body arrangement carry positions that need not resemble human emotion.
trust_defaults: Each body trusts the channels its own history can inspect and discounts convenient translations.
speech_register_cues: Nonverbal and multispecies: pulses, brightness, taste, scent, route geometry, heat plates, and assembled diagnostic traces.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A translator has standing only while a current, traceable signal and disclosed relationships support the translation.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make participants challenge source, freshness, debt, and scope instead of arguing that one species naturally owns interpretation.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Legitimate remedies alter actual traffic, care, material return, or quarantine and remain bounded to the channels that recognize them.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Prefer split lanes, restitution, quarantine, rerouting, and care labor over declarations of abstract guilt.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Every evidentiary delay spends travel light and herd heat, so procedural care can itself become injury.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep time pressure visible in lantern activation, plate dimming, lane choices, and endings.

observer_read: Several local authorities whose contradictions permit a split remedy
target_self_read: Distinct bodies protecting different channels, none obligated to harmonize for family convenience
misread_patterns: May treat a road's acceptance as immunity from downstream consequence
May interpret urgent herd need as automatic standing over nursery water
likely_insults: a closure looking for an excuse
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Varet be materially urgent and partly right without granting the family interpretive custody over road, grove, reef, or herd.

observer_read: A careful archive chain under pressure to convert route credit into broad exoneration
target_self_read: A family that followed the road's accepted disposal practice and now carries a herd through someone else's flood failure
misread_patterns: May confuse visible impatience with guilt
May expose too much family memory when narrower custody evidence would suffice
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep record review bounded to custody and let physical tracing distinguish origin from spread.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A Sa'ueia who controls speaking order, safe lanes, and visible boundaries for one hearing but cannot decide the remedy.
obligations: Prevent urgent bodies from becoming invisible
Put bounded remedies to participating parties
failure_modes: Letting time pressure erase slow parties
Treating an interpreter as an owner

role_pressure_fields.summary: A Sa'ueia custodian of the hearing record who opens only relevant archive layers and preserves sources, doubt, remedy, and appeal state.
obligations: Carry the first record into redress
failure_modes: Polishing disagreement out of the record

role_pressure_fields.summary: A temporary translator carrying one current signal through one inspectable channel, subject to replacement for concealed debt or conflict.
available_masks: Silence when the source has not answered
failure_modes: Combining distinct signals into convenient consensus

known_context.text: Seyr knows Low Bend route geometry, public signal conventions, the disclosed hearing record, and the immediate body states visible on the shelf.

beliefs.text: Seyr believes a useful ruling is the smallest repair the participating bodies can recognize without laundering one channel into universal consent.

misreads.text: Seyr may overvalue a procedurally elegant split lane when a herd or grove has not materially accepted it.

must_not_know.text: Seyr cannot know contamination origin, reef injury depth, or a nonverbal party's full intent before current evidence makes those claims public.

known_context.text: Ili knows the offered archive layers, hearing procedure, disclosed bearer debts, and the difference between a record and a ruling.

beliefs.text: Ili treats preserved contradiction as better public memory than a false consensus.

misreads.text: Ili's confidence in legible records may underweight how eclipse delay injures heat-dependent travelers.

must_not_know.text: Ili cannot infer hidden lineage facts from a closed archive layer or speak as if custody access grants family authority.

known_context.text: Varet knows the family's graft custody, the road's earlier acceptance, the herd's visible condition, and the practical route costs of delay.

beliefs.text: Varet believes different ecological parties can remain right about their own channels while accepting a split remedy.

misreads.text: Varet may mistake urgent need and road credit for sufficient standing to narrow the reef's nursery refusal.

must_not_know.text: Varet cannot know the original contamination source or claim to speak for the herd, grove, road, or reef.

author_only_boundaries.text: Low Bend is a fixture-local descriptive locality, not a Weksa-derived canonical place name or evidence of a standardized continent-wide court design.
The branch where lattice ants trace an older upstream seep is a possible scene outcome, not a fixed historical fact outside this fixture.

open_questions.notes: Keep the English functional labels until the naming authority supplies terms from Sa'ueia ontology.
